title: Crossover Pilot Model
text: Represent crossover pilot model, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Type of control} sets Dynamics control; {Calculated value} sets the crossover frequency or pilot gain Crossover, {Controlled element gain}, {Pilot gain}, {Crossover frequency (rad/s)}, {Pilot time delay(s)}, {Pilot lead constant} and {Pilot lag constant}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Type of control
params.values: Dynamics control Proportional (default) | Rate or velocity | Spiral divergence | Second order - Short period | Acceleration(*) | Roll attitude(*) | Unstable short period(*) | Second order - Phugoid(*)

params.name: Calculated value
params.values: Crossover frequency or pilot gain Crossover frequency (default) | Pilot gain

params.name: Crossover frequency (rad/s)
params.values: Crossover frequency 3 (default) | scalar in the range of 1 and 10
